description: Single source of truth for project-relative agent-skill install paths and the MCP-client to skill-target mapping for Godot Open MCP. The CLI agent registry (cli/src/utils/agents.ts) owns the MCP-client id vocabulary; this manifest owns the per-client skill destination and the mapping from each MCP client id to one or more skill-target client keys. Future consumers (the Hub wizard, a setup-skills CLI command, a project-specific skill generator) must read this file instead of duplicating constants. To add or rename a client, edit this file — do not hand-maintain duplicate constants in TypeScript or elsewhere.
